show.description: After enduring a decade of a thankless, contractual marriage to save his grandmother, a devoted man grants his ungrateful wife a divorce when her manipulative ex-lover returns—only to find his hidden worth recognized too late when he becomes a global success and must return to save his estranged family from a dangerous extortion plot.
